content = note['content']

    if not line:
        continue
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artist_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
    else:
        title = line
        artists = []
    songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})

steps.code:
# Search for each song and collect matching song_ids
playlist_id = 654
spotify_token = spotify_login['access_token']
song_ids = []
for song in songs:
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(access_token=spotify_token, query=song['title'], page_limit=10)
    # Find a match where title matches and artist(s) match
    match = None
    for item in result:
        if item['title'].lower() == song['title'].lower():
            item_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in item['artists']]
            song_artists = [a.lower() for a in song['artists']]
            if all(any(sa in ia or ia in sa for ia in item_artists) for sa in song_artists):
                match = item
                break
    if match:
        song_ids.append(match['song_id'])
        print(f"Found: {song['title']} -> song_id {match['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {song['title']} by {song['artists']}")
print(f"Total found: {len(song_ids)}")
